plan.planning_summary: Refining route_03 based on iteration 11 observations. Prior 28-layer stacks achieved target scores 0.618→0.819→0.797 with valid candidate counts 2→9→8. Feedback directs Gaussian initialization centered on high-contrast thickness ratios from best design (HfO2 ~180nm, SiO2 ~60nm) with 20% increased mutation step size to probe feasible basin boundaries. Three complementary routes proposed: (A) Gaussian-initialized 28-layer with enhanced mutation, (B) reduced 24-layer count to test convergence-density tradeoff, (C) asymmetric pair-ratio topology exploring non-uniform HfO2:SiO2 thickness relationships. All routes maintain parent_route_id=route_03 per refinement chain requirement.

routes.title: 28-Layer Gaussian-Initialized Stack with Enhanced Mutation Step
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Initializing layer thicknesses from a constrained Gaussian distribution centered on the high-contrast ratios observed in iteration 11's best candidate (HfO2 ~180nm, SiO2 ~60nm) will increase the valid candidate pool above 12 by concentrating search in the narrow feasible basin, while 20% increased mutation step size will enable boundary probing without losing convergence.
routes.design_principle: Leverage empirical thickness distribution from prior optimization to inform initialization, reducing random search waste while maintaining exploration capability through enhanced mutation.
routes.proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica (28 finite layers total, alternating starting with HfO2)
design_variables: 28 independent layer thicknesses with Gaussian initialization bounds
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: HfO2 thickness range 150-210 nm feasible for deposition
SiO2 thickness range 45-75 nm feasible for deposition
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory suggests alternating high/low index layers maximize reflectance in target band
Empirical observation from iteration 11 best candidate shows HfO2:SiO2 thickness ratio ~3:1
expected_advantages: Higher valid candidate count due to informed initialization
known_risks: Gaussian concentration may miss alternative feasible regions
Enhanced mutation may cause numerical instability if step too large
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 28-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (28 finite layers). Initialize HfO2 layer thicknesses from Gaussian distribution centered at 180 nm with standard deviation 30 nm, bounded 150-210 nm. Initialize SiO2 layer thicknesses from Gaussian distribution centered at 60 nm with standard deviation 15 nm, bounded 45-75 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with mutation step size increased by 20% relative to default. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Maximize mean transmittance over 1000-1700 nm band and maximize mean reflectance over 300-450 nm band. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Per feedback directive: replace uniform thickness initialization with constrained Gaussian distribution centered on optimized high-contrast ratios from iteration 11 best design, and increase optimizer mutation step size by 20% to probe feasible basin boundaries and recover valid candidate pool above 12.

routes.scientific_hypothesis: Reducing layer count from 28 to 24 while maintaining Gaussian initialization centered on high-contrast ratios will improve optimizer convergence by reducing dimensionality, potentially increasing valid candidate count while maintaining acceptable dual-band performance.
routes.design_principle: Layer count reduction trades theoretical maximum performance for improved optimization convergence and manufacturing simplicity, testing whether 28 layers exceeds what is needed for the specified bandwidth requirements.

routes.title: 28-Layer Asymmetric Pair-Ratio Stack with Variable HfO2:SiO2 Thickness Relationship
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Allowing HfO2 and SiO2 layers to follow different thickness distribution patterns (HfO2 centered higher at 200nm, SiO2 centered lower at 50nm) will better exploit the high refractive index contrast between HfO2 and SiO2, potentially improving the reflectance band edge sharpness and transmittance band flatness.
routes.design_principle: Asymmetric thickness ratios leverage the n_HfO2/n_SiO2 ~1.95/1.45 index contrast more effectively than symmetric quarter-wave designs, following evidence that non-quarter-wave optimization achieves superior multi-wavelength performance.
